title: How We Review
description: How AI Porn Bible checks, tests and rates AI porn platforms.

sections.body: Every listing is checked before it goes live: we confirm what the platform does, what it costs, which devices it runs on and what its privacy policy says. Anything we couldn't confirm is marked Unverified or Not yet verified on the listing.

sections.heading: Ratings
sections.body:
Ratings are out of 10 and only appear once a platform has been properly assessed. Sub-scores (for example memory, freedom, value and privacy) depend on the category and are shown on each profile.

Every rating and review says whether it is based on hands-on testing or on research. We don't claim to have tested something we haven't.

sections.heading: Keeping listings current
sections.body: Platforms change prices and features constantly. Each profile shows when it was last checked. If you spot something out of date, tell us and we'll recheck it.
